text:
Switching topology to a push-pull CS stage with a deterministic resistor level shift for the PMOS gate. Iteration 2 failed because the follower left the PMOS nearly off. That collapsed vout to 0.34 V, which killed both gm and swing.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Follower mis-set PMOS gate (PMOS ~off, vout 0.34 V). Replace with exact level shift: IREF through RS (ibias->vin, bypassed by CB) so PMOS Vsg is set by design. Push-pull gm_n+gm_p, R to vin for gain/DC, vout centered between vdsat limits for swing."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Ip":    (55e-6, 35e-6, 66e-6),   # PMOS gain-device current (sets power)
    "gmidp": (17.0, 10.0, 22.0),      # PMOS gm/Id (moderate/weak inversion, low vdsat)
    "Lp":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),        # PMOS length
    "Ln":    (0.18, 0.15, 0.6),       # NMOS length (short -> low vdsat)
    "A_t":   (11.0, 9.0, 14.0),       # target |gain|, sets R
    "dvo":   (0.0, -0.12, 0.12),      # offset of vout from computed swing center
}

def _solve_w(lut, dev, L, vgs, vds, I, vsb=0.0):
    W = 5.0
    for _ in range(10):
        o = lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds, vsb)
        W = min(max(W * I / max(o["Id"], 1e-12), 0.42), 4000.0)
    return W, lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds, vsb)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    Ip, Ln, Lp, A_t = p["Ip"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"], p["A_t"]

    vo = 0.92
    R = 12e3
    for _ in range(4):
        In = max(Ip - (vo - vin) / R, 0.3 * Ip)
        Wn, on = _solve_w(lut, "n", Ln, vin, vo, In)
        mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], Lp, Ip, vds=vdd - vo)
        gm = on["gm"] + mp.gm
        G = on["gds"] + mp.gds
        den = max(gm - A_t * G, 0.25 * gm)
        R = (A_t + 1.0) / den
        vdn = max(on.get("vdsat", 0.12), 0.05)
        vdp = max(mp.vdsat, 0.05)
        vo = 0.5 * (vdn + vdd - vdp) + p["dvo"]
        vo = min(max(vo, 0.5), 1.3)

    # final consistent devices
    In = max(Ip - (vo - vin) / R, 0.3 * Ip)
    Wn, on = _solve_w(lut, "n", Ln, vin, vo, In)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], Lp, Ip, vds=vdd - vo)
    gm = on["gm"] + mp.gm
    G = on["gds"] + mp.gds

    # PMOS gate level: ibias = vin + iref*RS  ->  Vsg = vdd - vin - iref*RS
    vshift = max(vdd - mp.vgs - vin, 0.05)
    RS = vshift / iref

    dn = lut.size("n", max(on["gm_id"], 3.0), Ln, In, vds=vo)
    ctot = cl + dn.cdd + mp.cdd + dn.cgd + mp.cgd

    gout = 1.0 / R + G
    A = (gm - 1.0 / R) / gout
    f3db = gout / (2 * PI * ctot)
    gbw = A * f3db

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "ibias", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("RS", "ibias", "vin", RS)
    n.C("CB", "ibias", "vin", 2e-12)
    n.R("RL", "vout", "vin", R)

    vdn = max(on.get("vdsat", 0.12), 0.05)
    vdp = max(mp.vdsat, 0.05)
    swing = 2.0 * min(vo - vdn, vdd - vdp - vo)
    power = vdd * (Ip + iref)
    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vo,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
